name: Mongolia
summary: Mongolia taxes residents' income from property at flat rates: 10% on net capital gains from securities and 10% on dividends and interest (5% for shares of local listed companies), 2% of gross proceeds on real estate sales. Foreign tax is credited. No wealth, inheritance or gift tax; annual immovable property tax of 0.6% to 2%. Corporate tax 10%/25%.

regimes.name: Mongolia tax residence
regimes.description: Flat 10% on gains and dividends; no wealth or inheritance tax.
regimes.eligibility: Tax resident: 183+ days in 12 consecutive months, or 50%+ of total taxable income from Mongolia.

capital_gains.summary: Income from the sale of movable property, including securities, is taxed on a net basis at 10% for residents (Personal Income Tax Law; PwC). Sale of immovable property is taxed at 2% of gross proceeds.

open_questions: Whether a gain on foreign real estate falls under the 2% gross rule or the 10% net rule was not verified.
PwC states residents are taxed on income from property but the individual pages do not spell out worldwide scope; inferred from the foreign tax credit provision.
capital_gains.rate_basis: Flat 10% on net gains from securities (domestic or foreign) and on shares of private companies. Local real estate 0.02 = 2% of gross proceeds (a higher share of the gain itself; recorded as the statutory rate). Foreign real estate not verified (null).
capital_gains.professional_trader: Business income of individuals is taxed under separate rules; not analysed.
capital_gains.foreign_assets: Residents are taxed on foreign income with a credit for foreign tax up to the Mongolian tax on that income.

dividends.summary: Dividends received by individuals are taxed at 10% (withheld at source when Mongolian-paid). A 5% rate applies to dividends on shares of local entities traded on local or international stock markets (excluding mining and petroleum licence holders). Foreign tax is credited.

dividends.rate_basis: Flat 10% on dividends; domestic scored at 10% (5% only for listed local companies).
dividends.withholding_outbound: 20% WHT on dividends paid to non-residents (treaty rates lower; 5% for listed local shares).
dividends.treaty_network: About 26 treaties (PwC), including Germany, France, UK, Switzerland, Singapore; no treaty with the United States.

sources.title: Mongolia - Individual - Other taxes (last reviewed 8 Jun 2026)

wealth_tax.property_tax_note: Annual immovable property tax of 0.6% to 2% of the value of owned property, set by local councils (PwC). Not a wealth tax.

inheritance.summary: No inheritance, estate or gift tax (PwC).

sources.title: Mongolia - Individual - Other taxes (last reviewed 8 Jun 2026)

open_questions: Whether gifts or inheritances received by individuals count as taxable income under the PIT Law was not verified.
inheritance.gift_tax: No gift tax (PwC). Income-tax treatment of gifts received not verified.

residency.tax_residency_test: Resident if present 183+ days in 12 consecutive months, or if 50% or more of total taxable income is earned in Mongolia (PwC).

routes.name: Residence permit (investor/permanent)
routes.requirements: Foreigners need a residence permit from the Immigration Agency; an investor category exists. Terms and amounts not verified.

corporate.summary: CIT 10% on the first MNT 6 billion of taxable income and 25% above; 1% on revenue for small entities; dividends, interest and royalties taxed at 10% gross.
corporate.special_zones: Free Trade Zones exempt buildings from immovable property tax.

sources.title: Mongolia - Corporate - Taxes on corporate income

us_citizen_notes: US citizens remain US-taxed; no US-Mongolia income tax treaty in force. Mongolian tax is creditable in principle.
